title: Spectral gaps and slow modes of Pauli rotations and random quantum circuits
summary: We determine which representation sectors control the slowest convergence of random Pauli rotations and several local random quantum circuits. For $d=2^n$, the continuous Pauli walk has exact all-representation gaps $$Δ_{\mathsf{SU}(d)}=\frac{d-8}{8(d-1)}\quad(n\ge4),\qquad Δ_{\mathsf{PU}(d)}=\frac{d(d-3)}{8(d^2-1)}\quad(n\ge3).$$ The special-unitary gap is attained in $\bigwedge^8\mathbb{C}^d$ and is invisible to balanced moments, while the projective gap is already attained in a balanced fourth-moment representation.
